payload.body:
You are often drawn to people who make your life feel larger by introducing you to ideas, experiences, beliefs, or possibilities you would not have reached on your own. Being close to them can make you reconsider limits you had stopped questioning.

The relationship can expand your worldview because the other person brings something genuinely different to it. They have been somewhere you have not, know something you do not, or take an idea seriously enough that you begin looking at your own assumptions differently.

Their certainty can start carrying more authority than your judgment. Someone can be knowledgeable, experienced, inspiring, and still be wrong about what is right for you.

Another person can expand your sense of what is possible without deciding what you should want. A relationship makes your life larger when both people can keep growing, not when the person with the bigger vision becomes responsible for choosing the future.
